S50Z26.today_summary: 1021.4 anchor (+2.9) sits 8.6 points below the 1030 max pain with ATM IV at 11.97%, a 7-session low, and a 1-sigma day of 7.70 points. Cumulative net GEX is negative at every strike from 950 to 1150 (total -3,612), so there is no gamma flip inside the listed range - dealers are short gamma throughout, with the per-strike sign turning positive only at 1030, making 1030-1050 the dampening band and everything under 1020 the amplification pocket. The live walls are 1000 on the put side (2,169 OI, 217 contracts traded today, 21.4 points away) and 1050 on the call side (1,945 OI, 170 contracts); the 1100 call wall (2,885 OI on 45 contracts) is structural, not active. 25-delta skew is -1.33 (call-rich) while the 10-delta tail runs +1.40 put-rich - near-money upside demand layered over cheap but bid downside tails.
what_changed: Net GEX shrank 62% to -3,612 from -9,434 on 7 Nov as spot climbed 30.1 points off the 991.3 low into the strikes where call gamma offsets put gamma.
ATM IV compressed 2.30 points to 11.97% from 14.27% on 7 Nov, pulling the 1-sigma day down to 7.70 points from 8.91.
1080 calls added 185 OI on 239 contracts of volume - the largest fresh build on the board today and the only Vol2Vol-confirmed flow above 1050.
Near put wall migrated back up to 1000 (2,169 OI) from 960 on 7-10 Nov, rebuilding the inner support 21.4 points under spot.
S50Z26.five_day_thesis: Max pain has held 1030 for five straight sessions after drifting down 10 points from 1040 on 6 Nov, and spot has converged up into it - from 991.3 on 7 Nov to 1021.4, now only 8.6 points below. Dealer short gamma more than halved over the same span (-9,434 to -3,612) because the rally carried price toward the 1030-1150 strikes where per-strike GEX is positive, so the amplification risk has migrated to the downside only. ATM IV compressed four sessions running (14.27% to 11.97%) while P/C OI fell 0.911 to 0.833 on 2,559 contracts of fresh call OI against 851 puts - positioning got call-heavier as insurance got cheaper. The 1100 call wall (2,885 OI) and 960 put wall (3,126 OI) have not moved once in seven sessions, so the structural box is 960-1100; what actually moved is the inner support, up from 960 to 1000. Cumulative net GEX never crossed zero anywhere in 950-1150 across the whole window, so the regime never flipped to long gamma - it only got less heavy.

S50Z26.prediction: 7.70 points of 1-sigma daily range and 46 days to 29 Dec expiry argue for a contained 1010-1040 drift as the base case, with spot pulled gently toward the 1030 max pain that has not moved in five sessions. The asymmetry is below, not above: 1030-1050 is a positive-gamma dampening band, while a close under the 1000 put wall opens the short-gamma pocket toward the unmoved 960 wall (3,126 OI, the largest single strike on the board). 1000 is the level that invalidates the constructive read.
S50Z26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and no position sizing is implied. SET50 options are European and cash-settled on the SET50 index, with no physical delivery, so the dealer-hedging mechanics behind pinning and max-pain magnetism are structurally weaker here than for share-settled single stocks: treat the 1030 anchor as a tendency, not a guarantee. At 46 DTE gamma is far from its expiry spike, so the pin is weak by construction, and macro or news flow can override the option structure outright. Defined-risk is not risk-free - the capped max loss on each structure above does happen.
